CSAT

E X E C U T I V E S U M M A R Y

Senior BFSI delivery executive with 18+ years of end-to-end program ownership across Core Banking, Payments, Lending, and Digital Transformation. Proven record of building delivery organizations of 80+ professionals, managing $3M+ portfolios simultaneously, and orchestrating multi-country go-lives across 14 nations. Combines deep domain expertise with C-suite stakeholder management, PMO design, and commercial acumen.

Now seeking a strategic leadership mandate — Delivery Head, Vertical Head, PMO Head, or AVP/Director — to drive scaled, profitable BFSI program delivery and elevate organizational delivery maturity.

C O R E C O M P E T E N C I E S

Leadership & Governance

BFSI Domain Depth

Delivery Excellence

▸ Delivery Head & PMO Setup ▸ Programme & Portfolio Management ▸ CXO Stakeholder Engagement (SteerCo) ▸ Governance Frameworks & RACI ▸ KPI Definition & Executive Reporting ▸ Pre-Sales, RFP & Solutioning

▸ Core Banking: T24, Flexcube 14.8, Universal Banking Essence ▸ Payments: ISO 8583 / ISO 20022 / SWIFT ▸ Retail, Islamic & Trade Finance ▸ Credit Decisioning: Experian PCSM / SDS ▸ API-led Integration & Digital Banking ▸ CRM–LOS–CBS Ecosystem Delivery

▸ Different Geo-Location -Go Live Rollout ▸ UAT Governance & Release Readiness ▸ Testing Centre of Excellence (TCoE) ▸ Risk Mitigation & Escalation Management ▸ Agile, Scrum, DevOps, CI/CD ▸ Regulatory-Compliant Delivery

SAIKAT NANDI | Program Delivery • PMO Governance • Core Banking Transformation • Strategic Execution | PMP®

S I G N A T U R E A C H I E V E M E N T S

▪ Scaled Delivery Organization: Built and scaled a delivery organization of 80+ professionals spanning 15–20 concurrent

BFSI programs, maintaining CSAT above 90% consistently across all client engagements.

▪ PMO Architecture: Architected enterprise-grade PMO from ground up — governance model, RACI, milestone tracking, KPI

dashboards, SteerCo reporting — enabling predictable, audit-ready program delivery at scale.

▪ Testing Centre of Excellence: Established Testing Centre of Excellence (TCoE), institutionalizing test governance,

automation frameworks, and quality gates — achieving zero critical defect escape rate across all production go-lives.

▪ Multiple Go-Live: Directed multi-country Core Banking go-live across 5 nations for Standard Bank of Africa

— coordinating deployment sequencing, production readiness, hyper care, and regulatory compliance across diverse geographies.

▪ Digital Transformation (CIB Egypt): Led end-to-end digital transformation for CIB Egypt (Experian PCSM/SDS):

Customer 360° credit dashboard, decision automation, and CRM integration — transforming lending operations across cards, loans, and mortgages.

▪ Active Multi-Client Portfolio: Currently owning a multi-client portfolio (Amana Bank, Lesotho Post Bank, UCS SACCO) — full lifecycle FCUBS & iCust delivery: infrastructure, parameterization, Multi interface integrations, UAT, and go-live readiness.

▪ CXO Engagement: Designed and sustained CXO engagement cadence — SteerCo forums, weekly governance, escalation

management — sustaining alignment through complex multi-year, multi-vendor programs with >90% CSAT.

P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E

Senior Project Manager — Portfolio Lead Client: Amana Bank | Lesotho Post Bank | UCS SACCO Rumango Software and Consulting | Bangalore

Jan 2026 – Present

Lead concurrent FCUBS & iCust banking implementation programs across three client organizations, owning full lifecycle from onboarding through production go-live and post-go-live hyper care.

▪ Directed client onboarding, kick-off, product walkthroughs, and functional/technical architecture alignment across 3

simultaneous banking transformation programs.

▪ Established delivery governance engine — milestones, Gantt planning, variance tracking, risk register, and

executive SteerCo reporting across all phases and clients.

▪ Manages full FCUBS implementation: infrastructure provisioning, environment validation, module installation,

parameterization across Retail, Islamic & Trade Finance products.

▪ Orchestrates 5-interface integration delivery (Sybrin, ATM Switch, AML, Currency Upload, SMS Gateway) — interface

study, development, SIT management, and defect resolution.

saikatnandi.slg@gmail.com • +91 98863 73705 • Bangalore, India

SAIKAT NANDI | Program Delivery • PMO Governance • Core Banking Transformation • Strategic Execution | PMP®

Senior Manager — Delivery & Testing Client: Commercial International Bank (CIB), Egypt Digitide Solution Ltd (QuessGTS) | Bangalore

Nov 2017 – Dec 2025

Led delivery governance, testing operations, and quality assurance for large-scale BFSI digital transformation programs, managing 80+ member teams and $3M client engagements across 8 years.

▪ Built, led, and mentored cross-functional teams of 80+ across concurrent BFSI programs spanning core banking,

payments, digital channels, and credit decisioning platforms.

▪ Established Testing Centre of Excellence (TCoE) — governance model, automation strategy, ALM/JIRA tooling, and CXO-

level quality reporting — institutionalized across the enterprise.

▪

Implemented Experian PCSM & Strategy Design Studio for CIB Egypt: credit scoring, risk evaluation, decision automation, and Customer 360° lending dashboard across cards, loans, and mortgages.

▪

Integrated Experian decisioning with Salesforce CRM, enhancing customer profiling, credit risk assessment, and lender productivity across the retail credit portfolio.

▪ Drove UAT governance, regulatory validation, data controls, and release readiness — achieving zero critical defect

escape rate on all production go-lives over the 8-year tenure.

▪ Owned multi-vendor coordination across OEM partners, fintech vendors, and internal teams — managing SLAs,

escalations, and delivery accountability at the enterprise level.

Techno-Functional Consultant — Payments & Core Banking Client: National Bank of Kenya | Co-operative Bank of Kenya Finastra Software Solutions (India) Pvt Ltd | Bangalore

Nov 2012 – Oct 2017

▪ Deep expertise in ATM switching (ISO 8583), ISO 20022 payments, teller systems, and Finastra core banking — supporting

national-scale banking infrastructure across Kenya.

▪ Delivered production support for high-volume banking systems, maintaining system stability, SLA uptime, and regulatory

compliance in 24x7 critical banking environments.

▪ Led cross-functional teams to resolve critical production incidents, reducing turnaround time and establishing

operational run-books for continuity.

Implementation Consultant — Core Banking Client: Standard Bank of Africa (SBA), Johannesburg Finastra Software Solutions (India) Pvt Ltd | Johannesburg

Set 2007 – Jun 2010

▪ Contributed to flagship Core Banking implementation and legacy modernization across multiple SBA

geographies, covering solution design, configuration, and testing.

▪ Key role in Lending and MoneyGram module pilot implementations, enabling new product lines across target markets.

▪ Coordinated multi-country go-live across 14 nations — deployment sequencing, production readiness, and post-go-live

stabilization.

saikatnandi.slg@gmail.com • +91 98863 73705 • Bangalore, India

E D U C A T I O N & C E R T I F I C A T I O N S

Academic Qualifications MCA — Master of Computer Applications GNIIT — Software Engineering, NIIT

Professional Certification PMP® — Project Management Professional PMI Certified

W H Y I A M R E A D Y F O R T H E N E X T L E A D E R S H I P L E V E L

Delivery Organization Builder I don’t just manage teams — I design and build them. PMOs, TCoEs, governance models, operating frameworks — built from scratch and sustained at scale.

Commercial & Pre-Sales Acumen Experienced in RFP responses, client demos, and deal closure support. I understand the P&L dimension of delivery leadership.

Global Delivery Veteran Multiple go-live experience across Africa, Middle East, and South Asia. Cultural intelligence and operational breadth for truly global leadership mandates.

Regulated Industry DNA Deep compliance expertise: UAT governance, data controls, audit-ready delivery, and regulatory adherence across banking systems in multiple jurisdictions.
